name: Personal access token
description: A token a user (or an enterprise service account) creates in the Airtable developer hub, with chosen scopes and base or workspace access, and passes as a bearer token to the Airtable API.

blockers.summary: Token layout by issue date can be seen only on issued tokens, which are not created or inspected here.
